explanation: EXCLURAD (eta configuration, model=3 EtaMAID2023, bmom=6.53 GeV, ivec=1 proton, vcut=0.166 GeV^2, full O(alpha) RC) was run for the single kinematic point W=1.5929 GeV, Q2=0.4276 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0.651724, phi*=36 deg. Note: the executable hardcodes 'input.dat' as its input filename (open(unit=5,file='input.dat')) and ignores stdin redirection, so the requested kinematics were written into eta/input.dat before running, then the original template was restored afterward (the exact input used is preserved as eta/input_run_used.dat). Delta and sigma_born were read from eta/radtot.dat, column 6 (sigar(1)/sibar(1), the ratio of the radiated to Born cross section) and column 7 (sibar(1), the unpolarized 5-fold differential Born cross section in the code's internal units), respectively, matching the source's write(28,...) statement in exclurad.F. Values are reported exactly as printed by the code, unrounded.
